environment.description: Node.js 18.x Apollo Server 4.x running on an EC2 instance in a public subnet with internet gateway attached. The instance has a public IP and full outbound connectivity. No reverse proxy or WAF in front of the application. The server listens directly on port 4000 exposed via security group ingress rule 0.0.0.0/0:4000. Response headers are passed directly to the client without any header sanitization middleware.

config.network: public subnet with IGW, security group allows all egress
config.proxy: none - direct client connection to Apollo Server
config.node_http_version: native http module (no header validation pre-v20)
